meta.name: The Final Call 720p
meta.description: The lives of passengers of a flight from Mumbai to Sydney are endangered after the captain decides to commit suicide on board.

videos.title: The Pilot
videos.overview: When his co-pilot of Skyline flight 502 accidentally gets poisoned soon after take-off, Captain Karan Sachdev cuts all communication with air traffic control, thus raising  suspicion on him.

videos.title: Off Comm
videos.overview: Pari is bombarded with questions from ATC Officer Kiran Mirza about the in-flight activities. Karan requests an emergency landing raising all the suspicion on him.

videos.title: Power of the Forces
videos.overview: Karan reminisces of his air force days and Kiran of her armed forces. A shocking twist in the tale occurs when Karan refuses to land the plane.

videos.title: Do You Copy?
videos.overview: Krishnamurthy’s prediction comes true. Meanwhile, Karan gets instigated and takes the plane into a thundercloud leaving Kiran's efforts in vain.

videos.title: The Journeys That Matter
videos.overview: Dhruv and Sarah share their personal matters with each other. Krishnamurthy tries to calm Abhimanyu’s soul. Meanwhile, ATS and ATC seek Pari’s help.

videos.title: Change in Plans
videos.overview: Pari and some passengers try to reach out to ATC to inform them of the truth. Meanwhile, Kale asks Kiran to step aside as she is emotionally compromised.

videos.title: The Finale
videos.overview: After hitting a low point, Kiran requests Kale to let her negotiate with Karan. What does destiny have in store for them in this nail-biting finale?
